map.依据 WHO 第5版标准评估精液密度、活力等参数并计算总活动精子数 TMSC，用: Evaluates semen density, motility and other parameters against the WHO 5th edition standards and computes the total motile sperm count (TMSC) for male fertility assessment and initial infertility screening.
map.不育初诊把精液常规各项与 WHO 第 5 版下限比对，标出未达标项。: At the initial infertility workup, compare each semen parameter with the WHO 5th edition lower limits and flag the items that fall short.
map.复查前后参数趋势跟踪。: Track the trend of parameters across repeat visits.
map.教学演示参考下限含义。: Use the reference lower limits to explain the meaning in teaching.
map.：浓度 15×10⁶/mL（达下限）、前向运动 PR 32%（低于 32% 参考: Concentration 15×10⁶/mL (at the lower limit), progressive motility PR 32% (below the 32% reference), normal morphology 3% (below 4%). The tool flags the low motility and morphology for follow-up.
map.一次不合格就是不育？: Does one abnormal result mean infertility?
map.不是，结果受禁欲天数、取样完整性与状态影响，异常常需 2-3 次复查。: No. Results are affected by abstinence days, sample completeness and current condition; abnormal findings often need 2-3 repeat tests.
map.参考下限用第几版？: Which edition is used for the reference lower limits?
map.多用 WHO 第 5 版（2010），部分用第 6 版，报告应注明；不同版数值不: The WHO 5th edition (2010) is used most often and the 6th edition in some places; state the edition on the report, because the values differ between editions.
map.能据此开药吗？: Can I start medication based on this?
map.不能，治疗由生殖/泌尿科医师综合决定。: No. Treatment is decided by a reproductive or urology physician based on the full picture.
